milestone: Shared CPU int8/uint8/int16/uint16 arrays, scalar and array record fields, and local worker integration

implementation.capabilities: Collection storage availability is independent from tensor arithmetic; ten CPU scalar and array element types, six source tensor element types; narrow GPU/tensor operations remain gated
implementation.frontend: Typed construction/empty arrays, exact map input/output/capture types, branches, indexing, slicing and concatenation reuse existing array semantics; scalar/array record fields retain exact width and nominal record identity
implementation.backend: CPU numeric lowering and task backend reused without modification; existing element-aware memrefs, byte widths, scalar alignment and per-element array worker layout identities
implementation.runtime: Existing record descriptor validator admits every implemented scalar storage width, with all pointer/size/stride/owner validation preserved; no allocator or scheduler redesign
implementation.cli: Array-specific admission and decimal printing for four narrow types using signed/unsigned promotion; tensor admission unchanged; existing limits and managed display leases retained
implementation.limits: CPU arrays and scalar/array record fields only. Narrow tensor source values, elementwise arithmetic/conversions/reductions/matmul and GPU execution await qualification. No distributed transport or public native ABI. Copying remains the baseline

coverage: All 80 frontend checks freshly rebuilt, including exact narrow array/record type gates and rejection of tensor/GPU paths; eight syntax/semantic/placement/continuation checks, numeric type descriptions, all ten numeric storage descriptors and CLI display guards

Borrowed slices with same-width signedness and int64/uint64 bounds, interior offsets, positive/negative strides, empty ranges, invalid metadata, cancellation, allocation failures and source locations; concat order, aliases and byte/length overflow

Scalar record packet alignment/raw bits, guarded results, nested tasks/cached awaits and snapshots after caller settlement; collection record duplicated owners, failed-observation publication guards and data retained after source/destination/scheduler destruction
One/four-worker raw transport with cancellation, deadlines, admission and scheduler allocation failures at positions 1..20; malformed nested descriptors cannot publish results
Executable typed empty arrays, conditional length joins, narrow/wide conversion maps, lexical captures, direct array workers and all four array layout identities in a single program

Mixed scalar widths, Bool, String and array fields, nested immutable record updates, record arrays and record-valued callbacks; checked arithmetic overflow/error recovery and source allocation failures at positions 1..32
CLI exact signed/unsigned endpoints and bounded printing, retained interior display leases and malformed-span guards; local mapped library/project compiler/checker and compiled documentation
Existing six-type arrays, slices, concat, record workers, collection fields and CLI entry suites freshly passed in all four variants; fresh Metal CLI regression
qualification.scope: Focused qualification, not full-suite coverage. No production edits after final qualification started. Early test-only corrections preserved the established display element-count suffix and recognized that INT64_MAX one-byte cells fit a descriptor byte budget: slicing an empty range is valid and may own a zero-byte result. Wider invalid byte counts remain faults before access. Raw harnesses were generalized to exact 1/2/4/8-byte bit cells. JS prototype and website untouched.
